title: Standard Chartered Hanoi Marathon Heritage Race 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
seo_title: SC Hanoi Marathon Heritage Race 2026 Review
meta_description: Standard Chartered Hanoi Heritage Race review: 15,000+ runners from nearly 20,000 registrations in November 2025, 2,500 from abroad, 21 medical stations.
dek: Hanoi's November heritage marathon drew more than 15,000 runners in 2025, including 2,500 from nearly 70 countries. Here is what that edition was like, ahead of 2026.
verdict: The Standard Chartered Hanoi Marathon Heritage Race is Hanoi's most international marathon. The 2025 edition, over 8 and 9 November, had more than 15,000 runners from a record of nearly 20,000 registrations, and about 2,500 international runners from nearly 70 countries, almost double the year before [1][2]. The organisers set up 21 medical stations with 80 doctors and nurses along the route [2]. If you want a big November marathon in Hanoi with a strong international field and serious medical cover, it is a good choice.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: The race was held over two days: the 5 km and a 2.1 km kids' race on Saturday 8 November, and the marathon, half marathon and 10 km on Sunday 9 November 2025 [1][2]. More than 15,000 runners took part, out of a record of nearly 20,000 registrations [1].
About 2,500 international runners from nearly 70 countries took part, almost double the 2024 figure, which the organisers describe as the largest international field of any race in Vietnam [1][2].

sections.heading: Safety and Setting
paragraphs: Bach Mai Hospital was the medical partner for a second year, with 21 medical stations along the route staffed by 80 doctors and nurses trained in emergency field care [2]. The race also ran a smoke-free campaign along the course [2].
A three-day expo ran from 7 to 9 November [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a large, international marathon in Hanoi with good medical cover. Registrations hit a record in 2025, so enter early.
Remember that Hanoi now has several big marathons between October and November, each on its own route and date. Check which one fits your plans.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2025 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran the Standard Chartered Hanoi Marathon Heritage Race in 2025?
faqs.answer: More than 15,000 runners took part over 8 and 9 November 2025, out of a record of nearly 20,000 registrations. About 2,500 of them were international runners from nearly 70 countries, almost double the year before.

faqs.question: What medical support is there at the Hanoi Heritage Race?
faqs.answer: In 2025 Bach Mai Hospital was the medical partner, with 21 medical stations along the route staffed by 80 doctors and nurses trained in emergency field care.

faqs.question: What distances does the Hanoi Heritage Race offer?
faqs.answer: The marathon, half marathon and 10 km on the Sunday, and a 5 km for adults and a 2.1 km kids' race on the Saturday. In 2025 those were 9 and 8 November, with an expo running across the weekend.
